projection_contract.coordinates: PADS integer coordinates use 1/1500000 mm units and are deterministically rounded half-up to CoHDL's 1e-15 mm literal grid (maximum projection error 0.5 fm).
projection_contract.copper: Shape, size, position, rotation, repeated number, chamfer, and plated thermal-via drill are exact normalized source facts.
projection_contract.courtyard: Exact rectangles remain exact; segmented, polygonal, or PADS component keepouts become a conservative axis-aligned bounding rectangle.
projection_contract.mask: Native pad mask is retained. PADS levels 121/128 are explicitly Solder Mask Top/Bottom; their arbitrary polygons are counted separately but not projected because CoHDL supports expansion, not independent mask polygons.
projection_contract.paste: Native module paste follows copper. Direct PADS level 123 (Paste Mask Top) polygons would be containment-proved same-number overlays; the pinned current sources contain none, so paste follows the exact copper islands or continuous EP.
projection_contract.silkscreen: Pin 1 is regenerated as the semantic marker. Antenna keepout polygons are disclosed as exact silkscreen outlines; source body/fabrication graphics are omitted.
projection_contract.unnumbered: KiCad unnumbered copper lands receive stable MP1..MPn physical identifiers so CoHDL can retain them and device declarations can model them explicitly.

espressif_direct_cad.redistribution: normalized facts only; raw CAD is not bundled

kicad_footprints_secondary.role: symbol-reference cross-check only; direct Espressif CAD wins on mismatch
